DasMediaHub.changelog:
• Fresh New Look: Completely redesigned the app with a cleaner, more modern interface, featuring polished layouts and smoother animations for a premium feel.
• Stable & Reliable: We've officially moved out of the testing phase! We've refined every feature to ensure a solid, stable, and finalized experience for everyone.
• Better Download Tracking: Easily track your progress with new real-time speed indicators and detailed file size info (e.g., 10MB of 50MB saved).
• Faster & Lighter: Under-the-hood improvements make the app much snappier, more responsive, and better for your battery life.
• Improved Content Loading: Fixed issues with finding videos and music to ensure your searches and links always work reliably.
• Clearer Support: Redesigned the Help, About, and Privacy sections to make finding answers to your questions much easier and faster.
• Smoother Multitasking: Improved 'Picture-in-Picture' and background play, so your media keeps playing perfectly while you use other apps.
• Bug Fixes: Squashed several bugs to make downloading and organizing your media more reliable than ever.
